high_level_description: The image depicts a large, ornate window with a white curtain partially drawn to the sides, revealing an intricate coat of arms in the center. The coat of arms features a blue shield with a red heart at its center, flanked by two golden keys crossed over each other. Above the shield is a papal tiara, and below it is a fleur-de-lis symbol. The shield is encircled by a banner with Latin text that reads "IN VITAM UNICUM CINCTUM," which translates to "Bound for Life." The window is framed by two tall, red pillars adorned with gold decorative elements resembling
